[DIR007, LAG007]

- The four additional activities behave as alternatives: each is followed by A27 in about 88 to 96 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, they almost never share a trace, and their participation shares sum to roughly one occurrence per trace. [LAG001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008]

A08's outgoing mix also changed, but only 16 after-window traces contain A08, so that difference is weakly supported. [POS005, LAG005, OCC002, DIR002]

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, A06 takes place in the main sequence between A14 and A15, and one of four mutually exclusive activities, A19, A20, A25 or A26, takes place between A42 and A27, which previously followed A42 directly; A08 is executed far less often. Note that the many relation items describe overlapping trace behaviour, so the weight lies in this coherence, not in the item count. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, DIR009, POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, REL017, REL018, REL019, REL020, REL021, REL022, REL023, REL024, REL025, REL026, REL027, REL028, REL029, REL030, LAG001, LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007]
